rows.title: Westinghouse (a Brookfield Renewable sustainable-solutions investment) confidentially submitted a draft registration statement to the SEC for a proposed IPO
rows.detail: Brookfield Renewable's Q2 2026 interim report (6-K, 07-31-2026): the number of shares to be offered and the price range had not been determined; the proposed offering is subject to market and other conditions. Recorded here, not on the map (board question 61, 2026-10-19: IPO / listing filings are financing).
